comparison.objective: Lock a vinyl floor tile into a laid row; candidate transfers a bearing block onto a service jig.
comparison.physical_skill: Record angles a long tongue into a groove and lowers it to engage a click joint. Candidate butts two narrow support profiles and slides an uncaged block across their interface without opening a ball-loss gap.
comparison.success_condition: Record measures locked seams, lippage, end gap, pull resistance, release and stillness. Candidate measures full block transfer, rail–jig mating, ball retention, absence of separation/jam/damage, and stable release.
comparison.reason: Both involve alignment along an extended interface, but click-joint engagement and continuous containment of independently moving bearing balls are meaningfully different abilities.
